# Physical, Geometric, and Differential-Equation Verification

- Define coordinate systems, orientation, units, and sign conventions before calculation.
- Check dimensional consistency for every governing equation.
- Verify initial and boundary conditions numerically after solving.
- Reduce the step size or mesh size and report convergence of key outputs.
- Check conserved quantities, energy/mass balance, or known limiting cases.
- For collision and geometry logic, test touching, containment, parallel, degenerate, and empty cases.
- For ODE/PDE solvers, report method, tolerances, event handling, and integration failures.
- Separate schematic geometry from measured geometry and never invent missing coordinates.
